title: 1:1 prep - Olivia Hart / Max Evans (2026-03-24)
content:
Quick notes for my 1:1 with Max (AE) - goal: align on top customer risks, handoffs, and upcoming Q2 plays.

Agenda:
- 5min: Quick personal check-in (energy, time off, blockers)
- 10min: Recent wins + customer momentum (which accounts, why)
- 15min: Top 3 at-risk accounts + mitigation (who owns what)
- 10min: Handoffs / technical help needed from SEs / SOWs
- 10min: Ops / process improvements (billing, reporting, demo infra)
- 10min: Actions + next steps

Context / background:
- Max has been handling Enterprise A and B; both are in pilot with dedicated VPC talks. We need updated timelines for security review from Private team.
- Demo infra flakiness last week caused two delayed calls (root cause: stale model variant on dedicated infra). Engineering assigned a ticket but want CS to own customer comms.

Recent wins to highlight:
- Enterprise C: closed POC, expecting first paid seat next month (big cross-sell opp).
- SMB vertical: two quick-win pilots converted to paid on hosted tier (good reference logos).

Top at-risk accounts / discussion points:
1) Enterprise A (Primary risk: security review delay)
- Impact: could push revenue by 6+ weeks; they want private deployment + KMS integration.
- Ask for Max: confirm exact blocker (legal vs infra). We need an updated ETA from Private team.
- Proposed mitigation: offer interim hosted with strict data handling + NDA + SOC docs while Private team completes review. (Owner: Max)

2) Enterprise B (Primary risk: performance SLA concerns)
- They saw 300ms spike for streaming responses during demo; worried about production SLOs.
- SE follow-up: request detailed perf logs and provide recommended config (batching / quant profiles). (Owner: SE team, cc Max)

3) Mid-market D (Primary risk: cost sensitivity)
- Their usage pattern could be optimized with batching + caching; offer Redwood Optimize assessment pilot. (Owner: Olivia/Max)

Handoffs / deadlines:
- Private infra security ETA: need committed date by EOW (Mar 27). If not, escalate to Solutions Eng lead.
- Demo infra ticket: ENG-4879 (assigned to Raj) - need status update and a short customer-facing blurb we can use. (Owner: Max to coordinate)
- Quote / SOW for Enterprise C: finalize pricing worksheet and legal template by Mar 30. (Owner: Olivia)

Customer comms draft (points to propose to Enterprise A):
- Acknowledge the priority and give two paths: (1) accelerated hosted pilot with enhanced controls + NDA, or (2) wait for Private deployment ETA. Outline pros/cons and recommended path.

Ops / process feedback to raise with Max:
- Billing reconciliation: customers report confusing invoice line items (embedding vs generation). Propose a one-pager explanation and include sample invoice. (Action: Max + Finance)
- Demo environment flakiness: request weekly sync between SE/release-eng to catch regressions earlier. (Action: Olivia to propose calendar invite)

Questions for Max:
- Any internal bandwidth issues on your side (slide prep, partner intro)?
- Which customer stories should we prioritize for public case study next quarter?
- Are we seeing pushback on pricing tiers from new trials? Any pattern?

Action items (clear, owners, due dates):
- Max: get updated security review ETA from Private team and report back by 2026-03-27. (High)
- Max: coordinate with Raj on ENG-4879, provide customer-facing blurb by 2026-03-26. (High)
- Olivia: prepare SOW/pricing draft for Enterprise C and share by 2026-03-30. (Medium)
- Olivia + Max: draft comms options for Enterprise A (hosted interim vs wait) and send to customer by 2026-03-25. (High)
- Olivia: propose weekly SE/release-eng sync and send invite by 2026-03-26. (Low)
- Finance: (cc Max) create invoice explainer one-pager by 2026-04-02. (Medium)

Notes to self (follow-ups after 1:1):
- Capture any action changes in Salesforce: update Enterprise A opportunity stage + notes.
- Add a short blurb to the CS playbook about offering hosted-interim for security-delayed customers. Link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/CS-Q2-playbook
- Check recent demo logs (Mar 20-23) for patterns - ask SRE for perf sampling if needed.

Open questions / unresolved:
- If Private team cannot commit to ETA by EOW, should we escalate to VP of Private? (likely yes)
- Do we want a templated legal addendum for hosted-interim customers? (follow up with Legal)

Bottom line to land in the 1:1:
- Get explicit ETAs and owners for the three high-risk accounts, agree on customer comms this week, and lock SOW timeline for Enterprise C. Leave the meeting with next steps and dates.
